areas.definition: What operators use to run ingest and publish flows and inspect their state from a terminal.
areas.name: Operating

areas.definition: What analysts use to review evaluated results in the browser.
areas.name: Reviewing

areas.definition: The service that ingests records, evaluates them against rules, persists them, and publishes results.
areas.name: Processing

api.responsibility: Owns the HTTP API that the CLI and web UI call to start flows and read their state.
api.runs: Runs as a long-lived service the CLI and web UI call over HTTP.
api.summary: The HTTP service the CLI and web UI talk to.
api.why: Without it the flows have no process to run in.

cli.responsibility: Owns the operator command line that runs and inspects flows.
cli.runs: Operators run it from a terminal to start and inspect flows.
cli.summary: The command-line tool operators use to run flows.
cli.why: Without it operators cannot trigger ingest or publish.

content.responsibility: Owns the seed and spawn scripts the demo loads at start.
content.runs: Not run itself; the demo loads these scripts at start.
content.summary: Seed and spawn scripts the demo loads at start.
content.why: Without it the demo starts empty.

devtools.responsibility: Owns benchmarks and lint rules for the workspace.
devtools.runs: Developers and CI run it; nothing ships it.
devtools.summary: Benchmarks and lint rules for the workspace.
devtools.why: Without it regressions in rule evaluation go unnoticed.

docs.responsibility: Owns the worked examples the documentation compiles.
docs.runs: Not run; the docs build compiles the examples.
docs.why: Without it the docs drift from the API.

harness.responsibility: Owns the acceptance lane that drives the CLI and web flows end to end.
harness.runs: CI runs it against the CLI and web UI; nothing ships it.
harness.summary: End-to-end tests that drive the CLI and web UI.
harness.why: Without it a broken flow ships unnoticed.

lab.responsibility: Owns the quick-ingest spike that tries a streaming variant of ingest.
lab.runs: A developer runs it by hand to try a streaming ingest; nothing ships it.
lab.summary: A throwaway experiment with streaming ingest.
lab.why: Without it the streaming idea has no place to be tried.

orchestrator.responsibility: Owns the ingest and publish workflows and their queue.
orchestrator.runs: Compiled into the API service; runs inside it.
orchestrator.summary: The ingest and publish workflows and their queue.
orchestrator.why: Without it nothing coordinates rules and storage.

rules.responsibility: Owns the record model and the rule engine that evaluates it.
rules.runs: Compiled into the API service and the web UI.
rules.summary: The record model and the rule engine that checks records.
rules.why: Without it records cannot be judged.

schema.responsibility: Owns the shared entity and event types and their validators.
schema.runs: Compiled into every product component that exchanges entities.
schema.summary: Shared entity and event types with their validators.
schema.why: Without it packages disagree on record shapes.

store.responsibility: Owns persistence of records in SQLite and in memory.
store.runs: Compiled into the API service; reads and writes SQLite.
store.summary: Record storage in SQLite or in memory.
store.why: Without it nothing survives a restart.

web.responsibility: Owns the browser UI analysts use to review results.
web.runs: Analysts open it in a browser.
web.summary: The browser app analysts use to review results.
web.why: Without it results are only visible through the CLI.

edge_reasons.api->orchestrator: Handlers start flows and read their state.
edge_reasons.api->schema: Handlers validate request bodies against shared types.
edge_reasons.cli->orchestrator: Commands start ingest and publish flows.
edge_reasons.cli->store: The status command reads persisted records.
edge_reasons.devtools->schema: Lint validates fixtures against shared schemas.
edge_reasons.harness->orchestrator: The lane runs flows directly to check results.
edge_reasons.harness->web: The lane boots the web UI.
edge_reasons.orchestrator->lab: The ingest flow calls into the streaming spike.
edge_reasons.orchestrator->rules: Flows evaluate records with the rule engine.
edge_reasons.orchestrator->schema: The queue worker consumes typed events.
edge_reasons.rules->schema: The model reuses shared entity types and validators.
edge_reasons.rules->store: rules reach into the store adapter to read persisted records directly
edge_reasons.store->orchestrator: The memory snapshot reaches into the scheduler.
edge_reasons.store->schema: Queries map rows to shared entity types.
edge_reasons.web->orchestrator: Views trigger flows and show their state.

module_responsibilities.rules/engine: Compiles and evaluates rules against entities.

actors.name: Operator
actors.role: Runs ingest and publish flows from the CLI.

actors.name: Analyst
actors.role: Reviews results in the web UI.

system.name: Demo
system.purpose: Demo ingests records, evaluates them against rules, and publishes results to operators through a CLI and a web UI.
system.summary: A rules engine operators drive from a CLI and a web UI to ingest, evaluate, and publish records.
